title: Enterprise Connectivity: campaign reduction fraction
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following campaign reduction fraction for each named contract tier. Discount fraction for a recorded eligible campaign on primary usage; decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | campaign reduction fraction | 0.05 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | campaign reduction fraction | 0.05 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | campaign reduction fraction | 0.05 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | campaign reduction fraction | 0.05 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | campaign reduction fraction | 0.05 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | campaign reduction fraction | 0.05 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the campaign reduction fraction is 0.05.
